messages:
jing: Heads-up — calypso-v2 int4 bring-up showed a weird intermittent drop of U+200D (ZWJ) in mixed zh/ja captions. Repro is small but consistent: BLEU down ~4 on caption set when ZWJ present. Repro command: `./evals/run.py --suite locale/mixed_zh_ja --model calypso-v2 --quant int4 --seed 42`

ci-bot: CI job `evals/mixed-zhja-int4/1796524321` failed (exit 1). Logs: /ci/artifacts/1796524321/eval.log

mike: Reproed locally. FP16 baseline is clean. This looks quant-specific and happens more often at higher temp (0.7+). When it fails the detokenizer seems to collapse adjacent tokens around invisible chars.

sasha: Quick question — is this sampling-related or tokenizer mapping? If fp16 is fine maybe quantized token->piece mapping shifted? Any diffs in vocab file between fp16 and int4 builds?

jing: I dumped tokens for a failing example. See snippet (token ids mapped to visible repr):
```
# input: "東京\u200Dカフェで…"
tokens: [1032:"東", 4500:"京", 2:"\u200D", 678:"カ", 129:"フェ", 44:"で", 999:"…"]
decoded (int4): "東京カフェで…"  <-- ZWJ missing
decoded (fp16): "東京\u200Dカフェで…"  <-- ZWJ present
```

liam: That token dump is telling — the int4 decode path sometimes drops the explicit ZWJ token (id 2 here). Two hypotheses: 1) quantized vocab remapping (kernel-level) merges that id into neighbor when using the int4 kernel, 2) caching/batching + detokenizer trimming leading/trailing invisible codepoints.

olga: Customer impact: two customers using subtitle pipeline in production report avatar captions losing spacing/honorific markers in zh/ja. Risk = medium, might need a short rollback or a mitigation fast patch.

mike: Temporary mitigation we can flip in routing: add `sanitize_zero_width: true` to route config for calypso-v2 or pin these customers to the fp16 variant. Example config snippet: 
```yaml
routes:
  - name: calypso-v2-mixed-zhja
    model: calypso-v2:int4
    filters:
      - locales: ["zh-JP","ja-JP"]
    decode_options:
      sanitize_zero_width: true
```

sasha: I'll run a seed/temperature sweep across 10 seeds and temps [0,0.2,0.5,0.8] and post a small heatmap. Early peek: BLEU variance spikes when sample_entropy > 0.95 and >1 ZWJ per sentence.

jing: I put a minimal reproducer + raw outputs in our internal gist: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/1796524321-zwj-repro — added failing examples and the exact model artifact hashes. Opening a PR now to add `sanitize_zero_width` to the model card and a unit test to detect missing invisible chars.

liam: I'll run a bisect between int4 kernels (kernel v0.9 vs v1.1) and tokenize remap patch. Running: `scripts/quant/bisect_tokenizer.sh --model calypso-v2 --artifact int4 --range v0.9..v1.2`

mike: If bisect points to tokenizer remap we may need to regenerate merges for the quantized build or force a tiny kernel fix. If it's cache-related we can push prefix-cache flush on mixed-locale requests as a short-term band-aid.

olga: Good. Please label the PR `customer-impact` if mitigation lands. I'll notify accounts.

mike: Tagging for triage tomorrow @oncall-ml — pinging @sasha @liam @jing. Let's prioritize a short mitigation today and full root-cause next sprint. :thumbsup:
